summary: IperionX Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing its intention to redomicile its ultimate parent company to Texas, subject to shareholder, court, regulatory and other customary approvals. The move aligns its legal and capital-markets structure with U.S. operations. It expects to list common stock directly on Nasdaq, replacing its ADS structure, pending structuring and exchange approvals. The company also appointed Michael J. Loparco as independent non-executive director effective August 3, 2026. No financial terms, premium, or deal price were disclosed. Watch for shareholder and regulatory approvals, and Nasdaq listing mechanics.
